assessment.applicability_basis: OpenAI attributed the July 2026 ChatGPT/Codex access outage to coupled RBAC fallback logic, then reported a fix and recurrence. OpenAI identifies RBAC fallback coupling as the reason service access failed. The bounded outage is therefore not a withholding of service solely because a subject declined effective informed consent, which is the triggering condition of this clause.
